description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single hybrid attacks (0.90/3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] if entry damage was Ice/Dark, [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Kurasame (Ice, Dark)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Kurasame (Ice, Dark)
description.text: Increases [Ice/Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks and BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Ice or Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Kurasame (Ice, Dark) after using three Ice or Dark abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Arcane Boreal Blade+
description.text: Six single hybrid attacks (1.20 or 3.80 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Kurasame (Ice, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Buff Ice 20% (15s)], [Buff Dark 20% (15s)] and [(Ice/Dark) Ability Instant Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
